# codebase-ema

The canonical EMA daemon snapshot. Contains the live `control_plane/`
(event_log, store, replay, execution_supervisor, incidents/*, proposal_events),
`babysitter/`, `sessions/`, and `surfaces/hermes_client.ex` — i.e. the
EMA-truth / Hermes-execution split is already real in code, not just doctrine.
Holds ClaudeForge under `code/ema/claudeforge/` and the working
`hermes-provider.ts` seam.
